bias.en: Downtrend · new 52-week low, lowest close since June 2025
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 创 52 周新低，收盘创 2025年6月以来新低

read.en: Nvidia fell 3.3% on Nov 19 to $145.98, trading $145.71–158.13 (a new 52-week low), its lowest close since Jun 23, 2025. It is below the 5-day ($154.3), 10-day ($164.6), 30-day ($197.3), 200-day ($203.6) and 100-day ($210.5), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($162.37), and RSI is 19.6, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月19日下跌 3.3%，收于 $145.98，盘中区间 $145.71–158.13（创 52 周新低），为 2025年6月23日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$154.3）、10 日（$164.6）、30 日（$197.3）、200 日（$203.6）和 100 日均线（$210.5）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$162.37），RSI 为 19.6，深度超卖。

read.en: The close broke the $150.3–150.4 support and the $148.8 Nov 12 low, both now resistance; the $158.13 high stalled under the Nov 18 high. Resistance is $148.8–150.4, then $154.3–156.1 (5-day, Nov 16–17 closes) and $158.1–159.7 (Nov 18–19 highs). Support is $144.2–144.7 (June 2025 closes), then $142–142.7 and $140–141. A close above $150.4 would target $154–156; below $144.2, $142.

r.en: Nov 12 low $148.80; Nov 17 low $150.33; Nov 18 low $150.40, all lost
